method: Static source review plus inspection of supplied native WGL captures scene.png, level-fixed.png and character.png. Reviewer did not operate window interactively.

findings.summary: Opaque and transparent geometry need global passes
findings.evidence: Renderer exposes RenderPass selector; main renders all scene and character opaque geometry before transparent geometry.

findings.summary: Transparency sorting is per mesh; cross-mesh ordering remains limited
findings.evidence: Renderer now sorts transparent range bounding-box centers along camera forward after transform. main submits scene then character meshes, so transparent ranges cannot sort globally across those meshes.
findings.recommendation: Document approximate per-mesh sorting or add global transparent draw queue.

findings.summary: Original material capabilities exceed initial renderer
findings.evidence: Renderer now supports alphaReference, additive, binary/partial diffuse alpha classification and vertex-color modulation. Scene UV transforms are applied. Latest main still assigns diffuse only; authored alpha masks require host composition and alphaReference/additive propagation.
findings.recommendation: Finish host metadata and alpha-mask composition; validate against a textured scene capture.

checked_invariants: View matrix follows column-major OpenGL look-at convention.
Index bounds are checked before glDrawElements.
Vertex array byte offsets and stride match standard-layout Vertex.
Renderer restores depth writes after transparent geometry and before clearing each frame.
WGL context is created and made current before renderer initialization.
Win32 teardown releases current context before deleting context, releasing DC, and destroying window.
Focus loss clears held keys; Alt+F4 remains available through DefWindowProc.
WM_SIZE tracks client dimensions and minimized state.
visible_verification_checklist: Launch packaged EXE and confirm original Act 1 environment is visible with correctly oriented textures.
Orbit camera around opaque and transparent surfaces; confirm walls occlude correctly and foliage has no solid rectangles.
Resize, maximize, minimize, and restore; confirm aspect ratio updates and render returns.
Play camera timeline through movement and cuts; confirm camera does not flip or produce blank frames.
Switch idle, walk, and attack; confirm animated character remains visible with textures and no exploding geometry.
Hold movement, switch focus away and back; confirm movement stops on focus loss.
Close via window X and Alt+F4; reopen and confirm clean startup.
verification_note: Checklist describes required visual checks; none are marked passed by static review.
integration_review: Window/context remains alive through renderer use and explicit texture destruction.
Resize reapplies viewport and projection using current client dimensions.
Minimized loop resets timing before skipping frame; restore avoids huge timeline jumps.
Screenshot captures GL_BACK before SwapBuffers and reverses pixel rows for PPM top-to-bottom output.
Root fixed T timeline toggle; useTimeline selects free-camera pose after toggling off.
Character is drawn at identity; combined world framing may leave character outside useful visible area.

visual_evidence.observation: Early capture plain white cuboid/plane; not original scene acceptance evidence.

Assembled textured swamp geometry, bridges and structures visible from overview. Dark, zoomed-out presentation. Confirms geometry/texture GPU output; still does not prove camera controls, animation, original opening framing or final material fidelity.
Textured Prince model clearly visible with coherent body geometry and pose. Single image does not establish moving animation or all three clips.

resolved_followups: Renderer pass selector and host global opaque-then-transparent passes.
Renderer cutout/additive handling and texture alpha classification.
Renderer vertex alpha pass/blend detection after reviewer feedback.
